_note: Lines for the opening event (data/events/opening.json): the farmer comes in through the gate, Grandma Tome is waiting and shows the farm, then gives seed potatoes and goes home. Parts start at the ids greet, field, bin, road, gift, bye and alone; each ends with next: end.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: So this is the farm. The fence leans, and the grass is up to my knees...

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Ah, there you are! You have your grandfather's ears. I'm Tome, from the village down the road.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Tsuru, our village head, asked me to meet you. She has her hands full with the spring meeting today.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: The field has gone wild since he passed. Weeds, stones, stumps... Clear a corner first, then work outward.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Hoe the soil, sow, and water every morning. Rain does the watering for you, mind.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: By the house is the shipping bin. Whatever you put in it by six in the evening, the cart takes, and you get paid.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: The little stand beside it sells seeds and a bite to eat. Handy when the village shops are shut.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Out through the gate, the road runs east to the village. The shrine, the Yorozu Store, the Kurogane Smithy...

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Sayo keeps the store, Gen beats iron at the smithy. Pop in and say hello. They won't bite.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Oh, and these. Seed potatoes from my own garden. They like a sunny spot. Don't let them dry out!

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Well, my knees want their cushion. Come and see me at the shrine in the mornings. Welcome home, dear.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Welcome home... Right. Clear a corner, plant, water. Let's get to work!
